title: Live trade review: .claude/skills/live-trade-review/SKILL.md, the § 3 procedure, binding
note:
From docs/plans/live-trade-review-DESIGN.md § 8 (merged c5d8d225, operator-approved 2026-10-25 ~13:58Z). Parent LIVE-TRADE-REVIEW-DESIGN. Design § 3; scope per operator Q2 (real money + prop review/apply, paper record-only on Sonnet), pings per Q3 (applies and asks only). [2026-10-25 ~16:30Z session_01R3JNyuLvWTXNqU8HKspiHP] Skill written. Design section 3 example corrected to the pricing tool's numbers. FIRST LIVE RUN, read-only diag at 16:15-16:16Z: 9 open packages, 9 rows, validator green. Real money: ada_pullback_2h no_recommendation/insufficient_n (n=18 under the floor of 20; data question PI-20261025-LTR3SKIL-0001); xrp_pullback_2h hold, ev_positive (hold n=21 +0.97R worst -1.14R; cheapest tighten atr:1.5 +0.44R costs 0.52R, outside both bounds). Prop: trend_donchian_eth_prop pkg-2c3f338d9477499b flag_mechanics (package closed sl_cross 10-24 20:02Z, but breakout_2 still holds the short on the original -1R stop; the phone amend #a6 was refused, fails 6; tracked as PI-20261025-KERS1025-0002; manager woken 16:18Z). Paper record-only: iaum, gdx, spy, mhg, mgc (mechanics match) and gld_pullback_1h (known wedge PI-20261002-APBY4NTV-0001). [2026-10-25 ~16:45Z] DECISION PACKET (manager 16:15Z, operator intent: the repo builds the context, Claude judges). Skill section 1b defines the packet contract. 9 hand-assembled packets are committed in comms/live_review/packets/. Every row carries packet_sha (optional schema field, validator-checked against the packet file). skill_sha on the rows is the blob of the skill as landed; the run itself used the pre-packet draft of commit 53591938.
BUILD SPEC for scripts/ops/live_review_packet.py. Inputs assembled BY HAND this run, with the route used and its rough cost:
(1) open set: position_telemetry?limit=300, about 220 KB, one call; it misses non-telemetry legs.
(2) package sl/tp/meta/exit_plan_state: journal?table=order_packages&limit=150, about 740 KB.
(3) open trades per account: journal?table=trades&limit=1000, then &offset=1000 and &offset=2000, about 1.4 MB each. This is the most expensive step; it was needed to find the Aug-opened SPY and GLD trades.
(4) venue SL/TP and positions: bybit_open_orders, exchange_positions, alpaca_open_orders, ib_open_orders, 4 calls.
(5) prop: /api/bot/prop/tickets plus /api/bot/prop/status?account_id= for each of 3 accounts (not a diag route), plus 4 log_file prop_trail_state reads, which all returned {}.
(6) leg geometry (atr_stop_mult, trail_mult, tp_r): config/strategies.yaml, local.
(7) priced options: live_review_outcomes.py once per leg (8 runs). The args were hand-mapped from telemetry, and atr_stop_mult was looked up per leg.
(8) mechanics: a hand join of package sl/tp against venue trigger prices with tick rounding, plus trail-geometry arithmetic.
(9) cross-reference against existing pipeline items by grep.
INFERRED split: roughly half of this lane's tokens went to assembly, not judgment.
WANTED BUT COULD NOT GET:
(a) ATR now and the (trend, vol) cell now. No candles route in diag, so atr_now_over_entry and regime_cell_now are null on every row.
(b) perp funding vs the leg's assumption.
(c) the macro / news calendar (the news-veto feed).
(d) the phone amend refusal reason (/api/bot/prop/phone/pending needs device auth).
(e) tradeify_1 / velotrade_1 venue positions (their status carries no positions field).
(f) the GLD mark, inferred from unrealised P&L / qty.
(g) a per-account amend risk read (no RiskManager hook; see LTR-6).
(h) a per-leg live-vs-backtest / cost-fidelity verdict (not assembled this run).
